messages:
kevin: Heads-up — GreenFox Logistics just emailed AP saying our PDF invoice was rejected by their portal. They attached the rejection log. :grimacing:
kevin: Key errors: missing "Company Registration Number" in header, VAT number present on line items but not on invoice-level header, and their PO parser couldn't match line items because we output a combined description instead of separate PO line IDs.
kevin: They require: company registration (exactly as on corporate docs), VAT/Tax ID in header block, separate line-item numbers that match the PO (e.g. PO: 987654 line 1, line 2, etc.), and a remit-to EFT block.
megan: Ugh. Do we have a repro? Which template produced the PDF?
kevin: Looks like legacy template v2-invoice-compact. We call /billing/generate_pdf with payload from the invoices service. I attached the rejection email snippet below.
kevin: "finance@gfl-accounts.payments: Rejected — File failed validation. Missing Company Reg No. Line items 1,2 do not map to PO 987654 because descriptions are merged. Please resubmit."
finance-bot: Automated: invoice 2026-03-12-INV-889 triggered delivery failure to GreenFox (status: rejected_by_recipient). ErrorCodes: [MISSING_COMPANY_REG, PO_LINE_MISMATCH].
priya: @kevin can you paste the original JSON we sent to the PDF generator? Need to confirm if fields were missing upstream or collapsed by template.
kevin: Sure — here's redacted snippet:
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-889",
  "billing_entity": {
    "name": "Redwood Inference Inc.",
    "short_name": "Redwood",
    "tax_id": "US-45-1234567"
  },
  "billing_address": "100 Market St, SF, CA, 94105",
  "po_number": "987654",
  "line_items": [
    {"desc": "Inference hours + support", "amount": 12500},
    {"desc": "Overage tokens", "amount": 2300}
  ],
  "remit": {"bank": "Stripe Payouts", "account_ref": "****1234"}
}
```
priya: I can see we included tax_id only, not a distinct "company_registration_number" field. GreenFox expects a corporate registration number field named exactly "company_registration_no" in the PDF header. Our templates map tax_id -> header TAX ID, but company registration was only in our internal profile and not injected.
sarah: Quick fix plan: update template mapping for v2-invoice-compact to add header row "Company Registration No" pulling from billing_entity.company_registration_no (fall back to billing_entity.tax_id if absent). Also split line_items desc into separate PO line references. Are the PO line numbers available in our invoice model?
kevin: Not currently. Our ingestion merges lines when the customer didn't provide per-line PO refs. But GreenFox's parser requires explicit per-line PO references. They said their ERP can accept a comma-separated "PO line refs" field per line.
megan: Could we patch the PDF generator to create synthetic PO line refs when only one PO is present? e.g., assign line numbers sequentially and emit an explicit "PO: 987654 - line 1" column. That should satisfy their parser without changing upstream data.
priya: Yes, low-risk. Add logic in pdf-service: if invoice.po_number exists and items lack po_line_id, synthesize po_line_id = invoice.po_number + ":L" + (index+1). Then ensure the template exposes a separate column "PO/Line" in the invoice table.
sarah: I'll scope a template change: v2-invoice-compact -> add header blocks: Company Registration No, VAT Number (duplicated at header), and new table column "PO/Line". Also update CSS to keep layout within 8.5" x 11".
megan: ETA? This is blocking GreenFox payments. They said unpaid items will be late after EOM.
sarah: I can PR the template today, but need a small code change in pdf-service for the synthetic PO lines. @priya — can you own the pdf-service change?
priya: Yep. I’ll create a short patch and a test that validates the generated PDF JSON model includes the company_registration_no header and PO/Line column when conditions apply. Plan: branch pdf-po-line-fallback, add unit test, then regenerate a sample PDF and send to GreenFox for acceptance.
kevin: Also double-check remit block — GreenFox requires an EFT routing + account number (not masked) in the PDF for automated reconciliation. We currently mask account_ref by default. We should allow full remit details when sending to customer-facing PDFs for enterprise customers (config flag).
megan: That sounds like a permissions/config update. Finance needs an audit trail. @sarah can you add a toggle in the template metadata: reveal_remit_full = true for enterprise partners? We'll need a secure flag so only approved recipients get unmasked details.
sarah: Yes, template metadata supports booleans. Will add reveal_remit_full: [greenfox-corp] and include a consent/approval step in the billing UI.
kevin: GreenFox also asked for billing address split into two lines: company legal address + registered address line. They told us the exact string they expect. Priya, can the generator accept billing_entity.registered_address and surface it in header?
priya: I’ll wire billing_entity.registered_address into header fallback and include both lines when present.
finance-bot: Automated: created ticket FIN-4821 "GreenFox PDF validation failures - company reg & PO lines" assigned to priya, sarah.
sarah: I'll open the PR after coffee.
megan: Once patched, can someone manually generate invoice INV-889 with the new template and upload to GreenFox test portal? I can coordinate with their AP contact (jessica at gf-accounts).
kevin: Yes — megan, can you schedule the re-submit? I’ll attach the acceptance criteria from their rejection email.
megan: On it. Will loop in jessica and confirm their parser accepts the sample. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Thanks team. If we get several more of these from other partners we should consider making company_registration_no a required field in our billing API for enterprise accounts.
priya: Agreed — I'll add a non-breaking validation warning in the API today and add the required flag to the enterprise billing profile docs.
